value.answer: Honda Odyssey, I'd say. It's #1 in U.S. News with a 9.3 out of 10, and Edmunds says it's the one they most like driving. If gas mileage matters most, the Toyota Sienna is the one to look at, since its hybrid is standard. The rankings don't agree on a single winner, so this one's my call.
